integrity: The proof provides the exact local parity equivalence and an all-size weighted hard-core counting argument. Standalone direct and transfer-graph scripts were replayed and their output compared with included records.
scientific_limitations: Only third-iterate fixed states are classified; no higher-period census, no assertion of equivalence with staggered RCA54, and historical priority is qualified by possible unindexed sources. title: Hard-core classification of three-cycles in reversible second-order Rule 54
